# webtables/assign

> Assignment: to a variable, or through an address (fields, elements, `*p`).

truck [webtables](../webtables.md) · [source](../../../registry/webtables/assign.pkg) · translates [std/assign](../std/assign.md)

The value is evaluated before the address, as in bintables, so it is
pushed on the memory stack first and popped by the store. Targets of
size 1 (`u8`) store one byte.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit when target is var`

```nasm
(i64.store {target.addr}
{value}
)
```

### `emit when target size 1`

```nasm
(call $__pk_push
{value}
)
(i64.store8 (i32.wrap_i64
{target!addr}
) (call $__pk_pop))
```

### `emit`

```nasm
(call $__pk_push
{value}
)
(i64.store (i32.wrap_i64
{target!addr}
) (call $__pk_pop))
```
